decisions.reason: Offshore and renewable energy vessel management is a strategic growth area close to the core shipmanagement business, and demand for offshore wind is rising, so the unit is very likely retained.
Crew and corporate travel management is integral to the firm's crewing operations and became even more important during pandemic crew-change challenges, so it is likely kept.
The online vessel information portal is a flagship digital customer interface supporting transparency for ship owners, though it may be rebranded or merged into a broader digital platform.

The mobile vessel performance app supports the firm's efficiency and sustainability goals, but standalone apps are more prone to consolidation into integrated platforms, which gives it a moderate risk of being dropped.
